name: GOBBLE
description:
About This Game

With Scythariel at your side, you'll never bite off more than you can chew! That's because this demonic bird is capable of transforming into a scythe that can cut down your foes AND eat them. Corpses fuel unique abilities, letting let you traverse treacherous chasms and hunt down hidden secrets.

In GOBBLE, you'll explore a hand-painted world brimming with life. Watch as sounds drift across your screen in the unique stylings of this stunning 2D platforming adventure! Just don't take too long to stop and smell the roses—your family is missing, and it's up to you (and Scythariel!) to bring them home!

You Are What You Eat

Consume your enemies for extra health, then spend that health on super-powered abilities!

Complete Your Collection

Every stage hides its own collectibles. Do your best to track down every last one.

A Living, Rustling World

In GOBBLE's unique aesthetic, sound effects come to life! See the leaves rustle and the chill in the air in a brand new way!
short_desc: If you can't beat 'em, eat 'em! Use your demonic scythe to chow down on monsters and save your village in this rich action platformer.
